He tells his colleague Xiao Liu, "There are a total of 60 assignments, most of them are math assignments, some are English assignments, but there are almost no history assignments." Xiao Liu flips through and finds only 15 English assignments.

[Question]
Before Xiao Liu flips through, how many math assignments does he estimate?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before Xiao Liu flips through, he estimates there are 30 math assignments.
B. Before Xiao Liu flips through, he estimates there are 60 math assignments.
C. Before Xiao Liu flips through, he estimates there are 50 math assignments.
D. Before Xiao Liu flips through, he estimates there are 59 math assignments.
